subject: q10ja built: flush-safe VCT trace + traced sysctl (sha 4e41f979, spare 4096) + bisecting probe build
body: Image gpu/build/device-mmu-q10ja-candidate/ui-sched/nord2-ios-metal-q10ja-ui654fb60dvfs-cap3500-ram3776-sched.img sha256 4e41f979fff271fcc2971cf418138b74e7ebfa9d74cf35485d7b5dbd152348da, 33550336 B, boot spare 4096 (was 6144), FAILURES none, kernel 0b2650f1; 0310 regenerated (24069798), 0311 unchanged. Kernel: from VCT entry #4 on, 1.5 s delay() after the entry line and 0.5 s after the '=err' line (in the cdevsw wrapper, before any lock); kern.n2vctrace is now a SYSCTL_PROC that logs 'NORD2 VCT sysctl read|write left N' + 1.5 s before the write and 'NORD2 VCT sysctl set N' + 1.5 s after. Probe (guest file, rebuilt arm64-ios ad-hoc: gpu/build/device-mmu-q10ja-candidate/guest/n2vcd_probe sha 74b9da43...): logs 'woke after 45s' + 2 s, 'sysctl kern.n2vctrace=64' + 2 s, 'sysctl -> r errno; open ... next' + 2 s. That bisects in userland: if 'woke' is missing the death is not caused by the probe's kernel calls at all. vc3 facts: vcodecd[25] and n2vcd_selftest[56] were both killed by the kernel (CRASH sig 9, reason ns 1 code 0x7, far 0x2c0304000 / 0x2c02d4000 = inside the guest 4GiB reservation at 0x280000000) - vcodecd made only o0/INFO/c0 (close at its death), so nothing powered or held. q10jy/q10jz audit of the q10jz SYSCTL_UINT: standard static oid with a startup entry, like audio's kern.n2mic.*; and q10jy had no sysctl and died the same way, so the sysctl is not the common cause.
